method: Codex inspected the rendered local image with view_image in the authoring session.
scope: Four panels, legends, axis labels, units and numerical labels are readable.
Panel A identifies the changed replicate target and uses paired difference confidence intervals.
Panel B keeps mean and consensus target labels distinct.
Panel C retains sparse bins and labels n=1 on W and n=12 on T.
Panel D marks absent positive events instead of assigning Jaccard zero.
limitations: Single-session AI visual inspection; not human-read attestation, independent review or scientific validation.
